# Flow Field distribution license audit

Initial audit: 2026-10-11. Release-material review: 2026-10-12. Author repository snapshot: [61595774d51bbb6a83065375cbd50fb730b81e0e](https://github.com/ykob/sketch-threejs/tree/61595774d51bbb6a83065375cbd50fb730b81e0e). Distributed bundle SHA-256: `a3b22fc21faed41cfd34be26be8cf75deae439deb3ced8b224261f4aa5d1fd59`.

**Release-material conclusion: no identified license condition blocks distribution of this exact bundle and Flow Field noise texture with the accompanying notices.** The original license declarations, full standard terms and relevant source attributions are retained. The former local-only status is superseded by this review and the user's authorization to publish. This is a bounded software-materials assessment based on publisher evidence, not a legal certification or a claim that every upstream history has been exhaustively reconstructed.

## Scope and evidence

The author [package.json](https://github.com/ykob/sketch-threejs/blob/61595774d51bbb6a83065375cbd50fb730b81e0e/package.json) and [package-lock.json](https://github.com/ykob/sketch-threejs/blob/61595774d51bbb6a83065375cbd50fb730b81e0e/package-lock.json) were inspected. All 12 downloaded locked publisher archives matched the author's recorded SHA-512 or SHA-1 integrity. No dependencies were installed or executed.

Read-only parsing found 639 webpack modules and 388 shader strings. Source imports were traced from `src/js/main.js`, including bare GLSL imports; no local source imports remained unresolved. The original Flow Field branch reaches Three, Babel/polyfills and regenerator plus the GLSL force drag function. Other libraries listed below remain distributed inside the full collection bundle even when this branch does not execute them.

Vue 2.6.12 is declared and locked but has no reachable source import and no Vue implementation signature in this bundle. Its notice is preserved as supplementary evidence, not represented as a runtime dependency. UAParser 0.7.26 is actually embedded despite being marked a development dependency in the author's lockfile. Build tools such as gulp, webpack, image compressors, and GLSL loaders are not themselves shipped runtime libraries.

## Confirmed libraries and notices

The links below point to the exact publisher archives or primary license endpoints used. Current distribution paths and SHA-256 hashes are in [source.json](../source.json). The original 22 downloaded license/declaration files retain their bytes. The supplemental `glsl-force-MIT-NOTICE.txt` and `three-r128-source-attributions.md` are clearly marked as notices assembled for this distribution, not downloaded upstream originals. The earlier `notice-manifest.json` in the workspace audit directory is an unchanged record of the 2026-10-11 local review, superseded for release status by this report and `source.json`.

## Three core source-port evidence

Three r128 is itself a distribution of other code. These sources are visible in the shipped Three source and were not mentioned in its companion notice:

- Earcut v2.2.2 is an explicit source port in `src/extras/Earcut.js`. The [primary ISC license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mapbox/earcut/v2.2.2/LICENSE), Copyright (c) 2016, Mapbox, is preserved in [earcut-2.2.2-ISC.txt](earcut-2.2.2-ISC.txt).
- `src/math/Sphere.js` cites exact [MathGeoLib Sphere.cpp](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juj/MathGeoLib/2940b99b99cfe575dd45103ef20f4019dee15b54/src/Geometry/Sphere.cpp). That source header says Copyright Jukka Jylänki and Apache License 2.0. The [official Apache text](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.txt) is preserved in [Apache-2.0.txt](Apache-2.0.txt). The header and `expandByPoint` / `union` C++-to-JavaScript adaptations are identified in [supplemental attributions](three-r128-source-attributions.md).
- LTC/ACES shaders refer to [selfshadow/ltc_code](https://github.com/selfshadow/ltc_code). Its [license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/selfshadow/ltc_code/master/LICENSE), preserved in [ltc-code-BSD-attribution.txt](ltc-code-BSD-attribution.txt), says Copyright (c) 2017, Eric Heitz, Jonathan Dupuy, Stephen Hill and David Neubelt. It adds a paper citation condition to BSD-style redistribution conditions: *Real-Time Polygonal-Light Shading with Linearly Transformed Cosines*, Eric Heitz, Jonathan Dupuy, Stephen Hill and David Neubelt, ACM Transactions on Graphics / SIGGRAPH 2016, 35(4), 2016. [Project page](https://eheitzresearch.wordpress.com/415-2/).
- Three's sheen BRDF shaders cite Filament. [Historical v1.9.25 BRDF source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/filament/v1.9.25/shaders/src/brdf.fs) and [Apache 2.0 LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/filament/v1.9.25/LICENSE) were inspected; [filament-Apache-2.0.txt](filament-Apache-2.0.txt) retains the license. The referenced `D_Charlie` / `V_Neubelt` functions, upstream adaptation and research citations are recorded in [supplemental attributions](three-r128-source-attributions.md). This historical reference has no separate per-file copyright header; the exact commit originally used by Three is not asserted. Direct `/NOTICE` checks at this Filament tag and the cited MathGeoLib commit returned 404 on 2026-10-12.

## Resolved material gaps and scope conditions

1. **glsl-force: resolved by preserving the express declaration and supplying its named terms.** Locked commit `5fb78e89e58f2907cd8ebb09f9ff79573147e15c` contains three shader files, README and package.json. Its [package.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykob/glsl-force/5fb78e89e58f2907cd8ebb09f9ff79573147e15c/package.json), rechecked directly on 2026-10-12, explicitly declares MIT and author yoichi kobayashi. The missing standalone LICENSE is not a contrary license or a requirement to seek additional permission. [glsl-force-MIT-declaration.json](glsl-force-MIT-declaration.json) preserves the original evidence; [glsl-force-MIT-NOTICE.txt](glsl-force-MIT-NOTICE.txt) supplies the standard [MIT terms](https://spdx.org/licenses/MIT.html) and declared author, clearly labeled as a distribution supplement. It does not invent a copyright year or claim to be a recovered upstream license file. The conclusion relies on the package's own license declaration, not on applying the collection's license to unrelated dependencies.
2. **Three notices: explicit conditions addressed; historical limits retained.** Three r128 is expressly distributed under its [publisher MIT license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r128/LICENSE). Additional Earcut ISC, MathGeoLib/Filament Apache and LTC terms are retained, with source locations, attributions and upstream adaptation descriptions in [three-r128-source-attributions.md](three-r128-source-attributions.md). The LTC paper citation condition is met in both the retained full notice and that supplement. `Triangle.closestPointToPoint` credits *Real-Time Collision Detection*, (c) 2005 Elsevier Inc., and refers to an accompanying license; the [author companion site](https://realtimecollisiondetection.net/books/rtcd/) did not establish it in the material inspected. This remains a historical tracing limitation, not an identified adverse condition on the MIT-licensed Three distribution. We retain that attribution and do not claim to relicense the book or to have independently cleared its contents. No evidence found requires treating every mathematical reference as a new independent license gate.
3. **Asset scope remains binding.** Author README [license exclusions](https://github.com/ykob/sketch-threejs/blob/61595774d51bbb6a83065375cbd50fb730b81e0e/README.md#license) cover water/glass textures and skull/crystal/newyear2019/buddha models/assets, not Flow Field's noise.jpg. This distribution includes only Flow Field's noise texture with the author bundle. Do not add excluded assets on the basis of the collection's MIT label.
4. **Distribution materials must travel with the code.** The original [companion notice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykob/sketch-threejs/main/docs/js/main.js.LICENSE.min.txt), preserved as [bundle-LICENSE.txt](bundle-LICENSE.txt), contains only UAParser and Three headers. Keep it and the entire adjacent license collection with the deployed bundle; that short companion alone does not cover all included libraries.

The release check is to deploy `source.json` and this entire `licenses/` directory with the unchanged bundle and noise texture, and ensure the files remain publicly accessible. The audit is complete for this identified release scope; historical tracing limits above remain disclosed. A different bundle, newly added asset or changed upstream license requires a new review. No deployment or public availability is asserted by this materials report.
